reports.name: BOM Dispatch CustomerWise
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT BOM_NO as 'BOM Number',BOM_NAME as 'BOM Name',SO_NO as 'Sales Order No',C.CU_Name as 'Cumtomer Name',QTY as 'Schedule Qty',INV_QTY as 'Dispatched Qty'  
FROM sales_order,customer c  where c.cu_id=CUST_ID and CATEGORY_ID=2 and BOM_NO is not null and month(SO_DATE) =  {month} and year(SO_DATE) = {year} and C.CU_Name = {cust_name}

reports.name: BOM Dispatch Details
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT BOM_NO as 'BOM Number',BOM_NAME as 'BOM Name',SO_NO as 'Sales Order No',C.CU_Name as 'Cumtomer Name',QTY as 'Schedule Qty',INV_QTY as 'Dispatched Qty'  
FROM sales_order,customer c  where c.cu_id=CUST_ID and CATEGORY_ID=2 and BOM_NO is not null and month(SO_DATE) =  {month} and year(SO_DATE) = {year}

reports.name: BOM Dispatch Pivot
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT C.CU_Name as 'Cumtomer Name',sum(QTY) as 'Schedule Qty',sum(INV_QTY) as 'Dispatched Qty'  
FROM sales_order,customer c  where c.cu_id=CUST_ID and CATEGORY_ID=2 and BOM_NO is not null and month(SO_DATE) =  {month} and year(SO_DATE) = {year} group by C.CU_Name

reports.name: Distinct  Component Details - With Tools
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT 
    cu_name AS 'Parent Customer',
    CO_PARTNO AS 'Part_No',
    CO_PARTNAME AS 'Part Name',
    CO_NoOfOp AS 'No of Operations',
    MAX(mt_name) AS 'Material',
    ROUND((1/MAX(t.conVal))*1000,2) AS 'Total Wt',
    MAX(CO_WEIGHT) AS 'Component Weight',
    ROUND(ROUND((1/MAX(t.conVal))*1000,2)-MAX(CO_WEIGHT),3) AS 'Comp Scrap',
    ROUND((MAX(CO_WEIGHT)/ROUND((1/MAX(t.conVal))*1000,2))*100,2) AS 'Comp Yield (%)',
    MAX(CO_WIDTH) AS Width,
    MAX(CO_LENGTH) AS Thickness,
    MAX(CO_REVISION) AS Revision,
    MAX(gm_name) AS Grade,
    MAX(coalesce(pl_name,'')) AS Plating,
    MAX(coalesce(ft_name,'') ) AS 'Finish Type',
    MAX(CO_MICRON) AS Micron,
    -- Aggregate material names and tool numbers
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.MM_RawMtPartNo ORDER BY t.MM_RawMtPartNo) AS 'RawMaterial/s',
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.CT_TOOLNO ORDER BY t.CT_TOOLNO) AS 'Tool/s'
FROM components c
LEFT JOIN customer ON CO_CUSTID = cu_id
LEFT JOIN materialtypemaster ON co_materialtypeid = mt_id
LEFT JOIN grademaster ON CO_GRADEID = gm_id
LEFT JOIN plating ON CO_ELECTROPLATING = pl_id
LEFT JOIN finishtype ON CO_FINISH = ft_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        CT_COMPID,
        CT_TOOLNO,
        CT_RMID,
        MM_RawMtPartNo,
        ((1 / ((MT_Density * MM_Thickness) * MM_StripWidth)) * 
         ((1000 * CT_NO_OF_CAVITY) / CT_Pitch)) AS conVal
    FROM components_tool
    INNER JOIN materialmaster ON CT_RMID = MM_Id
    INNER JOIN materialtypemaster ON MM_MTID = MT_Id
    WHERE CT_ActiveYN='Y' AND CT_PPC='Y'
      AND CT_PITCH > 0 AND CT_NO_OF_CAVITY > 0
) t ON t.CT_COMPID = CO_ID
WHERE CO_ID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT CO_PARENTID 
    FROM components 
    WHERE CO_ACTIVEYN='Y'
)
GROUP BY CO_ID
order by cu_name,CO_PARTNO ;

reports.name: Distinct Customers
reports.queryTemplate: select CU_Name as Customer from customer where CU_Status = 'R';

reports.name: Distinct Raw Materials
reports.queryTemplate:
select MM_RawMtPartNo as RawMaterial ,MT_Name as Material ,MM_Thickness as Thickness ,MM_StripWidth as Width,hm_name as Hardness,GM_Name as Grade from materialmaster
	left join grademaster on MM_gmId=gm_id
	left join hardnessmaster on MM_hmId=HM_Id
	left join materialtypemaster on MM_mtId=mt_id where mm_activeyn='Y';

reports.name: Distinct Tools with PartNos
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT 
    ct_toolno AS Tool,
    max(TL_spm) AS SPM,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CT_PITCH ORDER BY CT_PITCH SEPARATOR ' ,') AS 'Pitch',
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CT_NO_OF_CAVITY ORDER BY CT_NO_OF_CAVITY SEPARATOR '  ,') AS 'Cavity', 
    COUNT(*) AS 'Component Count',
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(MM_RawMtPartNo), '')) AS 'Raw Material Count',
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN CO_PARTNO END), '') AS Component1,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN CO_PARTNO END), '') AS Component2,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN CO_PARTNO END), '') AS Component3,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN CO_PARTNO END), '') AS Component4,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN MM_RawMtPartNo END), '') AS RawMaterial1,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN MM_RawMtPartNo END), '') AS RawMaterial2,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN MM_RawMtPartNo END), '') AS RawMaterial3,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN MM_RawMtPartNo END), '') AS RawMaterial4
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ct_toolno,
        CO_PARTNO,
        CT_PITCH,
        CT_NO_OF_CAVITY,
        MM_RawMtPartNo,
a.TL_spm ,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ct_toolno ORDER BY CO_PARTNO) AS rn
    FROM components_tool 
    LEFT JOIN components ON CT_COMPID = CO_ID
    LEFT JOIN materialmaster ON CT_RMID = mm_id
    LEFT JOIN (select distinct TRIM(TL_tool_number) AS TL_tool_number,MAX(TL_spm) AS TL_spm from tool_life GROUP BY TRIM(TL_tool_number)) a on a.TL_tool_number = ct_toolno 
    WHERE ct_activeyn = 'Y'
) t
GROUP BY ct_toolno
ORDER BY ct_toolno;

reports.name: Tool BreakDowns
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT 
    TRIM(tool_no) AS Tool_no,
    SUM(tool_down = 'Breakdown') AS `Breakdown`,
    SUM(tool_down = 'RM Complete') AS `RM Complete`,
    SUM(tool_down = 'Schedule Complete') AS `Schedule Complete`,
    SUM(tool_down = 'Preventive Maintenance') AS `Preventive Maintenance`
FROM (select trim(PM_tool_number) as Tool_NO,'Preventive Maintenance' as tool_down from preventive_maintenance
union all
select trim(tool_no) as Tool_no,tool_down from tool_breakdowns) a
GROUP BY TRIM(tool_no)
ORDER BY Tool_no;

reports.name: Tool Breakdown Details
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT
    TOOL_NO AS `Tool No`,
    PART_NO AS `Part No`,
    PART_NAME AS `Part Name`,
    MACHINE_NAME AS `Machine Name`,
    DPR_PRODUCED_QTY AS `Produced Quantity`,
    ISSUE AS `Issue`,
    TOOL_DOWN AS `Tool Down`,
    OPERATOR_NAME AS `Operator Name`,
    DOWNTIME_AT AS `Downtime At`,
    ROOT_CAUSE AS `Root Cause`,
    ANALYSIS AS `Analysis`,
    ACTION_TAKEN AS `Action Taken`,
    REMARKS AS `Remarks`,
    SPARE_CONSUMED AS `Spare Consumed`,
    COMPLETED_AT AS `Completed At`,
    HOURS_SPENT AS `Hours Spent`,
    CURRENT_STROKE AS `Current Stroke`,
    NEXT_STROKE AS `Next Stroke`
FROM tool_breakdowns
WHERE tool_no = {tool_number};
